"""Generate four lengthwise brush strokes and record the Panda joint targets."""
import json, math, time, argparse
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from scipy.interpolate import PchipInterpolator
from PIL import Image
from rcb_brush import Session

DIR=Path('/app/output')
PX=227.1845065/1024

def path_of(nodes,step=.10):
 a=np.array(nodes,float); a[:,:2]=(a[:,:2]+.5)*PX
 t=np.r_[0,np.cumsum(np.linalg.norm(np.diff(a,axis=0),axis=1))]
 tt=np.linspace(0,t[-1],int(t[-1]/step)+1)
 f=PchipInterpolator(t,a,axis=0); root=f(tt); vel=f.derivative()(tt)[:,:2]
 vel/=np.maximum(np.linalg.norm(vel,axis=1)[:,None],1e-7)
 z=np.clip(root[:,2],0,15); O=np.maximum(0,-.0967*z*z+2.109994*z-.36001727)
 path=root.copy();path[:,:2]+=O[:,None]*vel;path[:,2]=z
 # Constant speed in three-dimensional tip space, 8 mm/s at 20 Hz.
 dist=np.r_[0,np.cumsum(np.linalg.norm(np.diff(path,axis=0),axis=1))]
 tt=np.linspace(0,dist[-1],int(np.ceil(dist[-1]/.4))+1)
 return np.column_stack([np.interp(tt,dist,path[:,j]) for j in range(3)])

def generate(nodes,out='trajectory',score=True):
 s=Session(instance='/app/instance.json');s.reset();p=s.primitives();s.record_start()
 def move(pos,speed=.06,settle=4):
  r=p['move_tip'](pos,speed=speed,settle=settle)
  if r['ik_failures']:print('IK',r,flush=True)
 def world(pt):
  x,y=s.geo.mm_to_world(pt[0],pt[1]);return np.array([x,y,.020-pt[2]/1000])
 for k,ns in enumerate(nodes):
  print('stroke',k+1,flush=True)
  pos=s.tip_pose()[0];move([pos[0],pos[1],.065])
  move([-.1,.15,.065]);move([-.1,.15,.023],speed=.025,settle=6);move([-.1,.15,.065])
  path=path_of(ns)
  start=world(path[0]);before=world(path[0]-(path[1]-path[0])/np.linalg.norm(path[1,:2]-path[0,:2])*3)
  before[2]=.032;move(before);move([start[0],start[1],.021],speed=.02)
  for pt in path:
   q,ok,err=s.ik(world(pt))
   if not ok:raise RuntimeError(('ik',pt,err))
   s.step(q)
  end=world(path[-1]);move([end[0],end[1],.045],speed=.015,settle=5)
  Image.fromarray(s.canvas()).save(DIR/f'{out}_canvas.png')
 actions=s.record_stop();s.save_trajectory(actions,DIR/f'{out}.npz')
 Image.fromarray(s.canvas()).save(DIR/f'{out}_canvas.png')
 np.savez(DIR/f'{out}_strokes.npz',**{f'stroke{k}':st['samples'] for k,st in enumerate(s.strokes())})
 print('actions',len(actions),'state',s.state_sha(),flush=True)
 if score:
  metrics=s.score();print(json.dumps(metrics,indent=2),flush=True);json.dump(metrics,open(DIR/f'{out}_metrics.json','w'),indent=2)
 return s,actions

if __name__=='__main__':
 ap=argparse.ArgumentParser();ap.add_argument('--nodes',default=str(DIR/'tuned.json'));ap.add_argument('--out',default='trajectory');ap.add_argument('--no-score',action='store_true');args=ap.parse_args()
 generate(json.load(open(args.nodes)),args.out,not args.no_score)
